SHAHEED UDHAM SINGH

Walk-in-Interview for the Post of Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator
Walk-in-Interview to fill up of Two (02) Posts of Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator
at Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab University Constituent College, Guru Har Sahai,
Ferozepur, purely on temporary basis at D.C. rate applicable at the place of
appointment for 89 days and further extendable as per the requirement will be held
on 02.04.2025 (Wednesday) as per the detail mentioned below:
Name of the Post: Clerk-cum-Data Entry Operator (02).
Educational Qualification, Age and other Norms: As per Panjab University rules.
Venue of the Walk-in-Interview: Office of the Principal, Shaheed Udham Singh Panjab
University Constituent College, Guru Har Sahai, Ferozepur.
Date of walk-in-interview: 02.04.2025 (Wednesday)
Reporting time: 09.00 AM
Time of interview: 11.30 AM onwards.
The eligible candidates are required to report in the office of the College at 09.00 AM
on 02.04.2025 in the office of the college and submit the prescribed application form
available at https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php along with two sets of
photocopies of the certificates for verification.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending aforesaid walk-in-interview.
Principal
